comments.body:
Yes, UZH offers them. They are open for both UZH and ETH student. As far as I know there are two type of courses one before the start of the semester (2 week long) and the other one throughout the whole semester. I took one before the start of my first semester and I really enjoyed it. If you want to known more here is the link: 
https://www.sprachenzentrum.uzh.ch/de/Sprachkurse.html
